name: zedek_tools
description: Bundled Zedek utility tools (no external deps, pure Python)

name: online_tools
description: Read-only internet research tools (Web Fetch, Wikipedia, arXiv)

name: playwright_tools
description: Browser automation tools via Playwright/Chromium. Risky — requires explicit confirmation for all tools.

name: github_tools
description: Read-only GitHub API tools: repo search, code search, README fetch. Set GITHUB_TOKEN for 5000 req/hr (60 without).

name: weather_news_tools
description: Real-time weather via wttr.in (no key) and news search via NewsAPI (set NEWS_API_KEY).

name: codeforces_tools
description: Codeforces competitive programming tools: user stats, problem search by tag/rating, contest list. No key required.

name: semantic_scholar_tools
description: Academic paper search via Semantic Scholar. Set SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY for higher rate limits.
